file_stem: RWB E1 061 Intake agent evaluation and L1 proposal E2a
title: Intake agent evaluation and L1 proposal [E2a]
goal: Turn the intake agent's shadow results into an approval report and a versioned L1 policy proposal for Risk
why: Moving an agent from shadow to L1 (it may recommend) is a governed decision with evidence: sample size, agreement, failures, cost and latency.
ace_note: No ACE read. The report reads agent runs and their scores.

writes.note: P2: autonomy L1, conditions, fallback, watch measures

stores: CSV and PDF exports for the steering committee
rules: BR1: the proposal names a DONE run, conditions, fallback and watch measures
BR2: conditions are checked against the scores
BR3: at least 200 cases in the evaluation
example: EV-INTAKE-001: 200 runs (188 ANSWERED, 7 TIMED_OUT, 3 GUARDRAIL_FAILED, 2 BELOW_FLOOR)
Cost 412.60 baht (2.063 per case), p50 4,100 ms, p95 9,800 ms
Proposal P2 L1 requires agreement >= 0.85 per gap type
